messages:
Alex: Quick sync — PR #432 (migration guide + JS/py SDK snippets) is ready. Target cutover is Thu 11:00 PDT. Need reviewers and confirmation the preview build is clean.
Marie: @Alex paste the preview link? I can do a tech pass after lunch.
DocsBot: Preview build queued: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/branches/pr-432 — checks running (link-checker, linter, build).
DocsBot: Link-checker flagged an external SSO URL in docs/migration/sso.md -> status: failed (1).
Alex: Noted. That SSO link is a staging URL — I'll swap to the canonical docstore URL. Also the JS snippet uses the new routing param, pinging @Devon to confirm API name.
Devon: On it. Quick heads up: the SDK now expects `routePolicy` (object) rather than `route` (string). I'll update the snippet. Example snippet I'm proposing:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood.Client({key: process.env.RW_KEY});
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'rwd-large',
  prompt: 'Summarize...',
  routePolicy: {latency: 'low', region: 'us-west-2'}
});
```
Devon: I'll run a local mkdocs build to make sure formatting is fine.
Tim: FYI the feature flag for the new docs path (feature: versioned-docs) will be toggled at cutover. We will move `/docs/latest/` -> `/docs/v1/`. Need redirects in infra and a deprecation blurb in the migration guide.
Sasha: Redirects are in infra PR but they land at 10:50 PDT. They won't be live until we promote at cutover. Suggest we hold merging until redirects are confirmed to avoid 404s.
Alex: Good catch. I'd rather wait than push live broken links. Could we gate merge on a label like `redirects-deployed` or a green check from infra?
Marie: Content-wise I'm happy to approve once the link and snippet changes are pushed. Link-checker will re-run on push.
Alex: Pushed SSO link fix and updated JS snippet; new preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/branches/pr-432/preview-2 — DocsBot should re-run checks.
DocsBot: Preview checks complete: build OK, link-checker OK, linter: 1 warning (line-length in a fenced code block). Suggest run: `prettier --write docs/migration/js.md`.
Devon: Fixed formatting and pushed. Also added a short paragraph clarifying precedence when both `routePolicy` and `region` are present. @Marie could you re-review?
Marie: Re-reviewing now. One nit: clarify what happens if `routePolicy.latency` is set to `low` but `region` is `eu-west-1` and model is only in `us-west-2` — add a sentence about fallback behavior. Otherwise LGTM.
Alex: Added a sentence about fallback to the nearest compatible region and a link to routing docs. Who will merge? Plan was to wait until infra confirms redirects live. @Sasha any ETA?
Sasha: Infra confirms redirect will be live by 10:50 PDT. I'll post verification in #release-channel as soon as it's up. If confirmed, merge at 10:55 to let CDN pick up redirects before 11:00 cutover.
Tim: Also remember to tag the PR with `release-cutoff: 2026-03-26T11:00:00Z` and mark `cherrypick: none` for late edits.
Alex: Tagged PR accordingly. Final checklist: Marie approval ✅, link checks ✅, linter ✅, infra redirect pending. Plan: merge at 10:55 if infra confirms; otherwise hold.
Sasha: Redirects live — verified 302 from `/docs/latest/` to `/docs/v1/` on staging and prod edge. :white_check_mark: I posted screenshots in #release-channel.
Alex: Merging now. Thanks all. I'll open a follow-up PR to add a deprecation note about `/docs/latest/` being removed in 2 weeks.
DocsBot: PR #432 merged by Alex at 2026-03-26T10:56:12Z. Preview removed and canonical site rebuilt.
Alex: Post-merge reminder: update any product emails that linked to `/docs/latest/` — I opened issue #987 to track.
Marie: Thanks everyone — great coordination. :tada:
